hook.text: Sickle cell disease is deadly—so why hasn't natural selection eliminated the gene?

buildup.text: Two copies of the sickle cell allele cause disease. One copy provides resistance to malaria.

discovery.text: In malaria regions, carriers with one copy survive better than those with zero or two copies.

twist.text: This is heterozygote advantage—carrying both alleles is fitter than being homozygous for either.

climax.text: Balancing selection maintains harmful alleles in populations because they provide a hidden benefit.

punchline.text: Sometimes a 'bad' gene is also your best defense.

quiz.question: Why does the sickle cell allele persist in human populations?
options: It has no effect on survival

details.summary: Balancing selection maintains multiple alleles in a population rather than driving one to fixation. Heterozygote advantage, frequency-dependent selection, and variable environments all preserve genetic diversity by favoring different alleles under different conditions.
details.whyItMatters: Balancing selection explains why harmful alleles persist in populations. Sickle cell allele carriers gain malaria resistance, explaining why this seemingly harmful allele remains common in malaria-endemic regions.
takeaways: Heterozygote advantage keeps both alleles when the heterozygote is fittest
Frequency-dependent selection favors rare alleles, preventing fixation
Sickle cell trait persists because carriers resist malaria

faq.question: How does sickle cell demonstrate balancing selection?
faq.answer: People with two sickle cell alleles have sickle cell disease. People with no sickle alleles are vulnerable to malaria. Carriers with one copy of each resist malaria without full disease. In malaria regions, this heterozygote advantage maintains both alleles.

faq.question: What is frequency-dependent selection?
faq.answer: Selection where an allele's fitness depends on how common it is. Rare color patterns in prey are more likely to surprise predators, giving rare morphs an advantage. As they become common, the advantage disappears. This cycling maintains multiple forms.
